Self.Wiki: Static map geometry loaded from the map's own model files (map/mXX/<map>/<map>_<model>.mapbnd.dcx). Armored Core VI builds almost all of its maps from assets instead, so map pieces are rare: 5 in 2 maps, m41_00_00_00 Watchpoint Alpha (m300001, m310002 x3) and m50_30_00_00 The Wall (m390000). A map piece has no type data of its own; the game uses its model, transform, display groups, draw settings and grass. Use an Asset when the object needs collision, events, breaking or animation.

ModelName.Wiki: The map piece model (mXXXXXX), loaded from the map's <map>_<model>.mapbnd.dcx. It must also be listed in the MSB's models.

EntityID.Wiki: Identifies the map piece in event scripts. A short ID (below 10000) is expanded to the map's full entity ID at load. Retail: 0 on every map piece.

EntityGroupIDs.Wiki: Entity groups the map piece belongs to, for event scripts. Retail: empty on every map piece.

DisplayDataStruct.Wiki: The display groups of the map piece: it is drawn while any of them is shown, for example while the player stands on a collision whose display groups include it. Retail: set on all 5 map pieces.

GrassConfigStruct.Wiki: GrassTypeParam rows for dynamic grass on the surface. The grass code reads them through the shared map object code; use on a map piece is not confirmed. Retail: none on any map piece (grass is set on assets).

UnkStruct88.Wiki: Read through the shared map object code; no map piece-specific use found. Retail: all 0 on map pieces.

UnkStruct90.Wiki: Read by the game; meaning open. Retail: 0 on 4 map pieces, 2 on one (m41_00_00_00).

GparamConfigStruct.Wiki: No effect for a map piece: only asset code reads the Light Set ID (collisions keep their own). Retail: -1 on every map piece.

UnkStruct98.Wiki: No effect for a map piece. Holds no editable values.

UnkStructA0.Wiki: No effect for a map piece. Holds no editable values.

UnkE3C.Wiki: No effect for a map piece: only asset code reads it. Retail: -1 on every map piece.

UnkE3E.Wiki: No effect found: the game has a getter for it but nothing calls it. Retail: 0 on every map piece.
